text: Fall 2026 Full-Term Session key dates: Last day for regular registration is Aug. 20. Classes begin Aug. 24. End of late registration and last day to add/swap is Aug. 31. University closed for Labor Day on Sept. 7. Census Day and last day to drop without a "W" is Sept. 9. Withdrawal period ends Nov. 9. Fall break (no classes) is Nov. 23-25. University closed for Thanksgiving Nov. 26-29. Last day of classes is Dec. 9. Reading day is Dec. 10. Final exams are Dec. 11-16. Winter break is Dec. 22-Jan. 1.

Fall 2026 First 8-Week Session key dates: Last day for regular registration is Aug. 20. Classes begin Aug. 24. End of late registration and last day to add/swap is Aug. 31. Census Day (end of late registration and last day to add/swap or drop without a "W") is Aug. 31. University closed for Labor Day on Sept. 7. Withdrawal period ends Sept. 28. Last day of classes is Oct. 12. Final exams are Oct. 13-17.

Fall 2026 Second 8-Week Session key dates: Last day for regular registration is Oct. 15. Classes begin Oct. 19. End of late registration and last day to add/swap is Oct. 26. Census Day (end of late registration and last day to add/swap or drop without a "W") is Oct. 26. Fall break (no classes) is Nov. 23-25. Withdrawal period ends Nov. 25. University closed for Thanksgiving Nov. 26-29. Last day of classes is Dec. 9. Reading day is Dec. 10. Final exams are Dec. 11-16. Winter break is Dec. 22-Jan. 1.
